dialogues.speaker: Matzil
dialogues.text: Yes. Just as people meow whenever they see a kitten, I can't help but call out to a Saurian whelp whenever I see one.

dialogues.speaker: Matzil
dialogues.text: Once they're a bit bigger, I can ride an adult Saurian and bring the kids along for a joyride.

dialogues.speaker: Matzil
dialogues.text: As they grow older, they begin to develop unique character traits and will choose the rider they identify with most.

dialogues.speaker: Matzil
dialogues.text: So the time when little Saurians follow you about innocently should be cherished.
